Hud.FullAttackText: Attacks with {what}, one swing after another. Each swing opens the normal attack roll (Normal / Advantage / Disadvantage, or your own dice), and damage follows as usual.
Hud.FullAttackHint: Left-click: attack. Right-click: pick another weapon. Esc on a roll pauses; Esc again stops. Clicking a weapon by hand still works and counts.
Hud.NoSwingsLeft: No swings left in your Attack action this turn. You can still click a weapon by hand if the GM allows it.
Hud.NewTurnHint: Out of combat there is no turn order: click to start a fresh turn (swings, Sneak Attack and follow-ups available again).
Hud.PoleStrikeGated: Pole Strike opens after you take the Attack action with a Quarterstaff, Spear or Heavy weapon with Reach.

FollowUp.NoFocus: No Focus Points left for Flurry of Blows.

FollowUpText.offhand: The Light property's extra attack, as a Bonus Action. Your ability modifier isn't added to its damage unless it is negative (or you have Two-Weapon Fighting).
FollowUpText.nick: Nick: the Light extra attack made as part of the Attack action, so it costs no Bonus Action. Once per turn.
FollowUpText.flurry: Spend 1 Focus Point and make {n} Unarmed Strikes as a Bonus Action. Each strike opens its own attack roll.
FollowUpText.martial-arts: One Unarmed Strike as a Bonus Action.
FollowUpText.hew: Great Weapon Master: you scored a Critical Hit or dropped a creature to 0 HP — one more attack with the same weapon as a Bonus Action.

Strip.Paused: Paused — the roll was closed. Resume, pick a new target or another weapon, or Stop (Esc). Swings you don't take stay on your Action pips.
Strip.AdvHint: For the next swing only. The roll dialog's own buttons work too.
Strip.QuickHint: After the first swing, roll the rest without the dialog (same Normal / Advantage / Disadvantage). Manual dice still ask for each roll.
Strip.StopHint: End the Full Attack here. Swings not taken stay available.
Strip.PickTarget: Target a creature for the next swing (Stop cancels).
Strip.AlreadyRunning: A Full Attack is already running — finish or stop it first.
Strip.NoWeapon: That weapon is no longer available.

Rule.sneak-attack: Once per turn, on a hit with a Finesse or Ranged weapon, if you have Advantage — or an ally who isn't Incapacitated is within 5 ft of the target — and you don't have Disadvantage.
Rule.frenzy: While raging, after Reckless Attack: extra d6s on the first Strength-based hit this turn.
Rule.colossus-slayer: Once per turn, on a hit against a creature that is missing any of its Hit Points.
Rule.divine-strike: Once per turn, on a weapon hit.

ToggleHint.ask: Ask (now): a '+ {name} {dice}' button appears on your attack cards; click it when the GM says you hit. Click to switch to Auto.
ToggleHint.auto: Auto (now): {dice} is added to the first eligible attack's damage this turn, with an Undo if it missed. Click to switch to Ask.

Rider.UndoHint: It missed: give back this turn's use (the GM just doesn't apply this damage).
Rider.Stale: That attack was on an earlier turn — use the button on this turn's attack card.
Rider.RecklessWhere: (turn it on from the Special bar)

fullAttack.Name: Full Attack button
fullAttack.Hint: A Full Attack button on the Argon Action bar for characters with 2+ attacks: every swing in a row, one roll dialog each. Off: no button; weapons work as before.

swingPips.Name: Swing pips
swingPips.Hint: The Action pips count swings (2 → 1 → 0) for characters with Extra Attack, also when weapons are clicked by hand. Off: one Action pip as before.

followUps.Name: Follow-up buttons
followUps.Hint: Off-hand, Nick, Flurry of Blows, Martial Arts and Hew appear as one-click buttons only when the character qualifies. Off: no extra buttons.

gateFollowUps.Name: Pole Strike only after attacking with a polearm
gateFollowUps.Hint: Polearm Master's Pole Strike shows on the Bonus bar only after the Attack action with a Quarterstaff, Spear or Heavy Reach weapon. Off: always shown.

riderOffers.Name: Sneak Attack and once-per-turn riders
riderOffers.Hint: '+ Sneak Attack 3d6' (and Frenzy, Colossus Slayer, Divine Strike) on attack cards, once per turn; each player can switch theirs to Auto. Off: use the feature items by hand.

weaponBonuses.Name: Two-Weapon Fighting and Great Weapon Master damage
weaponBonuses.Hint: Adds the ability modifier back to off-hand damage (Two-Weapon Fighting) and +Proficiency to Heavy weapon hits in the Attack action (Great Weapon Master). Off: add them by hand (don't also use GWM's separate damage button when this is on).

offhandModeReset.Name: Off-hand mode doesn't stick
offhandModeReset.Hint: After an off-hand attack the weapon's next attack defaults to its normal grip again. Off: dnd5e remembers Offhand.

offhandPip.Name: Off-hand spends the Bonus pip
offhandPip.Hint: An off-hand attack greys the Bonus Action pip, not the Action pip. Off: Argon's default.

seedWeaponSets.Name: Fill empty weapon sets
seedWeaponSets.Hint: Once, for characters whose Argon weapon sets were never set: set 1 = main melee weapon + Light off-hand, set 2 = ranged weapon. Never overwrites a set someone dragged.

multiattack.Name: Full Attack for Multiattack
multiattack.Hint: NPCs and Wild Shape forms get Full Attack from their Multiattack (e.g. Bite then Claw). Off: the Multiattack card as before.

recklessToggle.Name: Reckless Attack toggle
recklessToggle.Hint: A 'Reckless Attack: On/Off' button on the Special bar for Barbarians: it applies the Reckless effect (Advantage on Strength attacks until your next turn), which Frenzy's hint reads. Off: no button; apply Reckless by hand.

Hint.off: Off (now). Click when you make your first attack this turn: Advantage on Strength attack rolls until your next turn starts (the roll dialog then defaults to Advantage), and attacks against you have Advantage. Frenzy counts it.
Hint.on: On (now): Advantage on Strength attack rolls until your next turn starts; attacks against you have Advantage. Click to turn it off (a misclick).

Reckless.On: Reckless Attack: on until the start of your next turn.
